projection_chain: sensor_pose (mocap mm) -> T_mocap_to_cam -> camera intrinsics -> pixel; gel center via T_gel_to_rigid
note: Solved on 2026-09-09 at 07:41, a few hours after the recordings it is applied to. The recorder's live overlay ran on the June-26 epoch during collection, and projecting the GelSight centres into a mid-episode frame puts June-26 on the sensors while this epoch sits 20-40 px away; both solves fit their own points to 0.5-0.7 px and share an identical gel-to-rigid transform, so they disagree only about where the cameras were. This epoch is the operator's choice. The June-26 files are in the repository as calibration/epoch_2026-06-26 if you want to compare.
